abstract: DNA analysis of testicular seminoma (typical seminoma [TS] and anaplastic seminoma [AS]) and spermatocytic seminoma (SS) was performed to evaluate the relationship between the proliferative activity and clinical outcome, and also to determine the proliferative characteristics of SS. Nuclear DNA contents of 15 cases of TS, 17 of AS and three of SS were measured by flow cytometry. Cytofluorometric DNA analysis was performed on three cases of every tumor. All 35 cases showed aneuploidy in the flow cytometry. In comparison with TS, AS tended to have a higher percentage of G2M phase in one cell cycle, having more cell cycle numbers and containing cells of various DNA values. Many mitotic figures with larger atypical cells that characterize AS could be explained by these results. In SS, the diploid formation by the small cells and the appearance of large cells with a maximum DNA value of 40C were demonstrated. These ploidy characteristics were considered to result in the morphological expression of large, small and intermediate cells. The application of both flow cytometry and cytofluorometry to the same cases was beneficial.
abstract_ja: 精巣セミノーマ（典型的セミノーマ[TS]および未分化型セミノーマ[AS]）および精母細胞性セミノーマ（SS）のDNA解析を行い、増殖活性と臨床経過との関係を評価するとともに、SSの増殖特性を検討した。TS 15例、AS 17例、SS 3例の核DNA量をフローサイトメトリーで測定した。各腫瘍3例ずつについてはさらに細胞蛍光光度計によるDNA解析を行った。全35例がフローサイトメトリーで異数性を示した。TSと比較して、ASはG2M期の割合が高く、1細胞周期あたりの周期数が多く、様々なDNA値の細胞を含む傾向があった。これはASに特徴的な、大型で異型性の強い細胞を伴う多数の核分裂像をよく説明する結果であった。SSでは小型細胞の二倍体化と、最大40Cに及ぶ大型細胞の出現が認められた。これらの倍数性の特徴は、SSにおける大型・小型・中間型細胞という形態学的表現をもたらすと考えられた。フローサイトメトリーと細胞蛍光光度計の両方を同一症例に適用したことは有益であった。
